# GitHub Copilot instructions

Canonical instructions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at repo root. Follow it for stack, commands and conventions.

Quick reference:
- Prefer editing existing files over creating new ones.
- No premature abstraction; match existing style.
- Write tests for new behavior and run the suite before calling a change done.
- Never suggest hardcoded secrets or committing `.env` files.
